sv.title: C-ledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvists bakslag mitt i regeringskaoset
sv.summary: Centerledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist vill vara företagandets röst. Men flera av hennes egna affärer har ett dystert resultat. Mitt under regeringsförhandlingarna har ytterligare en av hennes investeringar slutat i konkurs – och två ledande företrädare polisanmälts.

en.title: Centre Party leader Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist suffers setback amid government chaos
en.summary: Centre Party leader Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist wants to be the voice of entrepreneurship. But several of her own business dealings have a bleak outcome. In the middle of the government negotiations, another of her investments has gone bankrupt, and two leading representatives have been reported to the police.
